analysis_scope.permutation_scope: one assignment per system and recording

frozen_rules.inconclusive: Neither the go nor stop rule is met.
frozen_rules.matched_budget_go: Guard micro cpCER is lower than prefix, suffix, triggered abstain, and the mean hash-delete result on both learned splits.
frozen_rules.matched_budget_stop: One comparator has lower micro cpCER on both learned splits and its comparator-minus-guard interval is below zero on at least one learned split.
frozen_rules.matched_budget_strong_go: matched_budget_go holds and every corresponding guard-minus-comparator paired 95% interval is below zero.

parameters.bootstrap_seed_derivation: base + source_offset(0/1000) + split_offset(0/100) + frozen comparator index
parameters.matched_budget_unit: Python Unicode code points per 30 s record
parameters.uniform_hash_definition: SHA256 of NUL-separated UTF-8 fields (seed,source,session,slot,segment_index,index); retain the L_guard smallest digests and restore original index order
